name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, and identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs while keeping SUB-only and DUB-only files correctly labeled.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Production WCO provider combining lightweight TV resolution with title-aware movies and Season 0 specials, legacy player extraction, Episode 0 and fractional-special fallbacks, separate Dub/Sub sources, season and range matching, plus stable pruning to the highest two qualities per detected media host with a maximum of four sources per audio branch.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: WCO Mirror Test
scrapers.description: Temporary isolated mirror test for normal WCO TV/anime episodes. Resolves WCO server and CDN independently as Mirror 1 and Mirror 2 and keeps only the two highest unique qualities per mirror. Production WCO remains untouched.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO mirror test
